text.name: Shale Revolution
text.rules: Record "energy independence". LIO spends 2 points. SAE chooses: Cut production? If yes, SAE spends 1 point, then until the end of this turn, points spent by SAE count 1 less, never below 1; if no, LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: Hydraulic fracturing and horizontal drilling raised US crude output to around 11 million barrels a day in 2018, passing the 1970 record and making the United States the world's largest crude producer.
